levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب
محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: Two isnads joined by «وَ حَدَّثَنِي» meet at محمد بن الحسين; the names after the meeting are written once, so they form the shared tail (rule 3).
«أبي» is a bare relation with no name (rule 7).
The Imam named after «عن» inside the chain stays a narrator (owner ruling 2).
